findings.title: MultiEdit payloads bypass pre:config-protection because run() only inspects top-level file_path or file
findings.detail: hooks/hooks.json:63 registers pre:config-protection with matcher "Write|Edit|MultiEdit", but scripts/hooks/config-protection.js:160 reads only `const filePath = input?.tool_input?.file_path || input?.tool_input?.file || ""` and ignores `input?.tool_input?.edits` (as well as `tool_input.path`). A MultiEdit call with `{ edits: [{ file_path: ".eslintrc.js", old_string: "error", new_string: "off" }] }` or a benign top-level `file_path` paired with a protected path in `edits` returns exitCode 0 and modifies the protected config.
findings.recommendation: Add `extractFilePaths(input)` in `scripts/hooks/config-protection.js` to collect trimmed paths from top-level `file_path`/`file`/`path` and each object entry in `tool_input.edits`; iterate over all candidate paths and use `continue` when a protected basename does not exist (`ENOENT`) so any existing protected file later in the batch is still blocked with exitCode 2.

history.from: Extract all candidate paths from top-level `file_path`/`file`/`path` and every object entry in `tool_input.edits`, and block with exitCode 2 if any target resolves to an existing protected config.

findings.title: Unconditional top-level process.stdin listeners in config-protection.js and post-edit-typecheck.js leak on require()
findings.detail: scripts/hooks/config-protection.js:216-243 and scripts/hooks/post-edit-typecheck.js:20-105 attach `process.stdin.setEncoding("utf8")`, `process.stdin.on("data", ...)`, and `process.stdin.on("end", ...)` at module top level without guarding behind `if (require.main === module)`. When `tests/hooks/hook-input.test.js:10` requires `config-protection.js` with an open stdin descriptor, the process hangs indefinitely after finishing all assertions because the leaked `stdin` data listener keeps the Node.js event loop alive. When required in-process before stdin closes, the top-level `end` listener also races the caller by writing raw stdin to stdout or calling `process.exit(2)`.
findings.recommendation: Wrap the CLI stdin fallback in both `scripts/hooks/config-protection.js` and `scripts/hooks/post-edit-typecheck.js` inside `if (require.main === module)`, and verify in `tests/hooks/config-protection.test.js` that `process.stdin.listenerCount("data")` and `process.stdin.listenerCount("end")` remain unchanged across `require()`.

history.from: Wrap the CLI stdin fallback in both `scripts/hooks/config-protection.js` and `scripts/hooks/post-edit-typecheck.js` inside `if (require.main === module)`.
history.to: Wrap the CLI stdin fallback in both `scripts/hooks/config-protection.js` and `scripts/hooks/post-edit-typecheck.js` inside `if (require.main === module)`, and verify in `tests/hooks/config-protection.test.js` that `process.stdin.listenerCount("data")` and `process.stdin.listenerCount("end")` remain unchanged across `require()`.

findings.title: post-edit-typecheck.js filters tsc diagnostics with raw line.includes(candidate), causing false positives on root/nested files and missing Windows backslash paths
findings.detail: While `stop-format-typecheck.js:135-143` was updated to parse the leading file path from `tsc --pretty false` diagnostics (`diagnosticMatchesFile`), `post-edit-typecheck.js:84-86` still checks `if (line.includes(candidate)) return true`. When editing root `index.ts` (`relPath = "index.ts"`), `line.includes("index.ts")` matches diagnostics from `src/index.ts(1,14): error TS2322` and `other-index.ts`. Conversely, on Windows where `filePath`, `resolvedPath`, and `relPath` use backslashes (`src\index.ts`) while `tsc` outputs forward slashes (`src/index.ts(1,14)`), `line.includes(candidate)` fails to match any candidate.
findings.recommendation: In `scripts/hooks/post-edit-typecheck.js`, extract diagnostic file headers via non-greedy `/^(.+?)\(\d+,\d+\):\s/` or `/^(.+?):\d+:\d+(?:\s+-\s+|\s*:\s*)/`, normalize `\\` to `/` and strip leading `./`, split output on `/\r?\n/`, and export `diagnosticMatchesFile`.

history.from: Replace `line.includes(candidate)` in `post-edit-typecheck.js` with `diagnosticMatchesFile(line, candidates)` that extracts the diagnostic header file path and compares normalized forward-slash paths.
history.to: In `scripts/hooks/post-edit-typecheck.js`, extract diagnostic file headers via non-greedy `/^(.+?)\(\d+,\d+\):\s/` or `/^(.+?):\d+:\d+(?:\s+-\s+|\s*:\s*)/`, normalize `\\` to `/` and strip leading `./`, split output on `/\r?\n/`, and export `diagnosticMatchesFile`.

findings.title: Dangling symlinks at protected config paths could bypass existence checks if fs.existsSync is used
findings.detail: Initial hypothesis that a dangling symlink at `.eslintrc.js` would return false from `fs.existsSync` and be allowed as a first-time config creation.
findings.recommendation: Verify whether `fs.existsSync` or `fs.lstatSync` is used in `scripts/hooks/config-protection.js`.

findings.title: stop-format-typecheck.js isolates session accumulators and skips third-party plugin clones
findings.detail: scripts/hooks/stop-format-typecheck.js:69-78 and 135-143 skip `.claude/plugins` checkouts and match `tsc` diagnostic file headers accurately.

findings.title: run-with-flags.js enforces plugin-root path containment and suppresses raw passthrough on truncated stdin
findings.detail: scripts/hooks/run-with-flags.js:231-315 validates `fs.realpathSync` containment under `pluginRoot` and suppresses raw stdout passthrough when stdin exceeds `MAX_STDIN`.

findings.title: hooks.json routes PreToolUse Write|Edit|MultiEdit to pre:config-protection and consolidates PostToolUse into sync/async dispatchers
findings.detail: hooks/hooks.json:62-71 wires `Write|Edit|MultiEdit` to `pre:config-protection` with a 5s timeout, and lines 144-166 consolidate PostToolUse hooks into two bounded dispatcher entrypoints.
